verdict.rationale: The only scoped credential documented is the embeddable MCP flow, where a user's Authorize click gives the backend a token limited to running that user's automations through AI. The general API keys are platform-level and span multiple projects, so they are not scoped. Action-level agent tool restrictions limit what an agent can do, not what a credential can reach, so they get no credit here. Missing for 10: per-key permission or scope configuration, least-privilege API keys for standalone (non-embedded) agents, documentation of token scope granularity, expiry or revocation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: your backend gets a token it can use to run that user's automations through AI
